members.bio:
Fenil P. Shah is an institution builder, researcher, student of management and President of the Ahmedabad Centre for Research and Innovation (ACRI). 

At ACRI, he contributes to the development of research ecosystems, scholarly publishing, institutional governance and initiatives that promote knowledge creation and dissemination. He also serves as Chairperson of the International Journal of Business & Management Research Studies (IJBMRS), where his work involves strengthening editorial processes, maintaining publication standards and advancing academic research.

His interests span institutional design, management, business analytics, education systems, public policy, research methodology, innovation and the intersection of technology and society. He is particularly interested in creating accessible, credible and sustainable platforms for interdisciplinary research and intellectual exchange.

Beyond academia, Fenil is actively involved in youth leadership, educational initiatives and public engagement. He is an organiser and licensee of TEDxThaltej Youth, through which he works towards creating platforms for ideas, dialogue and knowledge sharing.

He believes that research should extend beyond academic publication to inform institutions, influence practice and contribute meaningfully to society.
